body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Hardware Verification Testbench Generator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (UVM agent, driver, monitor, and scoreboard generation). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: UVM agent, driver, monitor, and scoreboard generation and Constrained-random sequence libraries. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Logic synthesis and optimization engine) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
